none: PAS CAM-A0B274: Copper-alloy Nummus of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I, 364-375. Mint is Arles, 364-375, Reece period 19. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]PF AVG in small lettering. Reverse shows Emperor with labarum dragging captive right. Reverse legend reads [GLORIA ROMAN]ORVM. Reverse mintmark is: OF I//[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.10g,…
